explication: Improve is an agent skill that audits a codebase and produces implementation plans; it does not implement source changes itself. The main workflow is recon, parallel audit, vetting and prioritization, then plan writing. Its documented branches include focused audits, feature suggestions, plan review, execution by a cheaper agent, reconciliation, and optional GitHub issue publication. The source excerpts were unavailable, so relationships below are limited to those explicitly described in the README; skill internals share the listed skill path.
